decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The outdoor play area
associated with the nursery shall only be used for outdoor play between the
hours of 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–17:00 Monday to Friday and shall not be used for
nursery outdoor play outside of these periods or on Saturdays, Sundays or Bank
Holidays.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The nursery use
hereby permitted, including use of the outdoor play area, shall at all times be
operated in accordance with the approved Acoustic Management Plan. The measures
contained within the Acoustic Management Plan shall be implemented from first
occupation of the premises as a nursery and shall thereafter be maintained for
the duration of the use.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
development hereby permitted shall be operated in accordance with the measures,
actions, monitoring and review arrangements contained within the submitted
Travel Plan (Velocity Transport Planning Ltd, Project No. 26/047, Document No.
D002, Version 0.4, August 2026). The Travel Plan Coordinator shall be appointed
prior to first use of the premises as a nursery and the Travel Plan shall
thereafter be implemented, monitored and reviewed in accordance with the
timescales specified therein.</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p>Prior to first use of the premises as a nursery,
the cycle, buggy and scooter parking/storage facilities shown on the approved
plans shall be provided in full and thereafter permanently retained and
maintained for their intended purpose.</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The nursery use
hereby permitted shall be operated at all times in accordance with the
submitted Flood Warning and Evacuation Plan (Version P1, dated 05 May 2026),
including the arrangements for registration for and receipt of flood warnings,
evacuation of the outdoor play area and premises, safe access and egress, and
provision of safe refuge. A copy of the Flood Warning and Evacuation Plan shall
be retained at the premises and made available to staff at all times when the
nursery is in operation.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p style="">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use
Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or any Order revoking and re-enacting that
Order with or without modification, the premises shall be used only as a day
nursery within Class E(f) and for no other purpose within Class E<span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:Swiss721BT-Roman;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-font-weight:
bold">.</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
Swiss721BT-Roman;mso-ansi-language:EN-US;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-font-weight:
bold"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p>The number of children
in attendance at the nursery shall not exceed 60 at any one time.</p>
description: change of use of the existing youth hall in association with Pinner Synagogue (Class F2(b)) to a Nursery (Class E (f)).
